title: The delivered water of a rocky or water planet against its formation distance and mass in the Bern population synthesis (GEN.802)
source: Bern NGPPS NG76 nominal-physics condensed-water population ([R0600], Nature Astronomy 8, 463, [R0601, R1268]), Zenodo 10527170 (file condensed/ref_evo5e9.dat, open, no licence field) with the starting semi-major axis at 100,000 yr from the DACE population ng76 (public). 10506 planets of 0.5 to 30 Earth masses at 5 Gyr, any final orbit. COMPUTED by the Citations lane (docs/design/composition/volatile-delivery-formation-distance.md) and refitted jointly in x and mass by Lane L (reports/gen802-files/fit_ngpps_formation_water.py in the project files). Only the fitted numbers and the binned shares are kept here.
label: COMPUTED
note: A MODEL result of a physics simulation, not a measurement. x = a_form / a_snow with a_snow = 2.69 AU at 1 solar luminosity; M is the planet mass at 5 Gyr in Earth masses; the water mass fraction f is the model's 'fice' column of the condensed-water run (its input is a 50 percent ice share of solids beyond the ice line, not the project's BC1 value).

classes.note: dry f < 0.00025; low 0.00025 to 0.0016; high 0.0016 to 0.1; rich f at least 0.1 (the hycean limit); the thresholds are the nearest-class mapping of the note's section 6 to Ortenzi's 0, 0.05 and 0.5 wt percent

model.form: logit P(f >= edge k) = a_k + b_k ln x + c_k log10 M + h_k max(0, ln x - ln knot); nested events held in order (high no more likely than not dry, rich no more likely than high)

fit.note: a straight logit in ln x gives -2787, one quadratic in ln x -2632, an ordered logit with shared slopes -2767; the hinge at 0.6 is the best of 0.3 to 1.0 (-2557)
